items.headline: Modest numbers in Week 8 win
items.text: Daniels completed 16 of 29 passes for 217 yards and a touchdown while rushing twice for 23 yards in Sunday's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

items.headline: Officially limited Thursday
items.text: McCaffrey (hamstring) was a limited participant at Thursday's practice, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

items.headline: Efficient with expanded opportunity
items.text: Black rushed 12 times for 63 yards and a touchdown and brought in one of three targets for minus-4 yards in the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday. He also lost a fumble and returned one kickoff for 34 yards.

items.headline: Another limited session
items.text: Pickens (hamstring) was limited at Thursday's practice, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.

items.headline: Forgettable afternoon in loss
items.text: London brought in one of six targets for eight yards in the Falcons' 16-0 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday.

items.headline: Logs full practice Thursday
items.text: Kelce (ankle) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

items.headline: Scores fifth TD in Week 8 win
items.text: Diggs caught three of six targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-10 win over the Eagles.

items.headline: Four grabs in defeat
items.text: Douglas caught four of six targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots.

items.headline: Zero catches in rain-soaked win
items.text: Godwin failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

items.headline: Ties career high in rushing yards
items.text: Warren rushed 17 times for 143 yards and a touchdown and brought in one of two targets for no gain in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.

items.headline: Logs another 'DNP' Thursday
items.text: Henderson (illness) was listed as a non-participant in Thursday's practice, ESPN's Rob Demovsky reports.

items.headline: Tosses one TD in Paris
items.text: Shough completed 30 of 38 passes for 278 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers. He added seven rushing yards on three carries.

items.headline: Not practicing yet
items.text: Head coach Kellen Moore said Wednesday that the Saints haven't opened Etienne's (hamstring) practice window just yet, Jeff Nowak of WWL Louisiana reports.

items.headline: Little production in OT win
items.text: McCarthy completed 20 of 28 passes for 252 yards and no touchdowns or interceptions in Sunday's 27-21 overtime win over the Texans. He added one yard on his only carry.

items.headline: Gains 37 total yards in return
items.text: Price rushed 10 times for 29 yards and brought in two of four targets for eight yards in the Seahawks' 34-17 loss to the Bears on Monday night.

items.headline: Career-high 147 rushing yards in Week 8
items.text: Allen rushed 21 times for 147 yards and a touchdown while catching both of his targets for six yards in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders.

items.headline: First 100-yard game of season
items.text: Chase secured 11 of 16 targets for 141 yards and a touchdown in the Bengals' 43-36 overtime win over the Titans on Sunday.

items.headline: Team-high yardage total in loss
items.text: McConkey brought in four of six targets for 86 yards in the Chargers' 24-9 loss to the Rams on Sunday.

items.headline: Limited Thursday
items.text: Kamara (rest/back) was limited at Thursday's practice, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.

items.headline: Out for third straight game
items.text: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Wednesday that Montgomery (groin) has made some progress but is still viewed as week-to-week and will remain out for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

items.headline: Five catches in blowout win
items.text: Bernard caught all five of his targets for 30 yards during Sunday's 27-6 win against Cleveland.

items.headline: Modest production in Week 8 win
items.text: Rodgers completed 13 of 25 passes for 172 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.

items.headline: Locked down in Week 8
items.text: Pitts caught two of five targets for six yards during Sunday's 16-0 loss to the Buccaneers.

items.headline: Steps up late as team's top RB
items.text: White rushed 11 times for 55 yards and a touchdown while catching two of three targets for five yards in Sunday's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

items.headline: Makes strong case for top job
items.text: Coleman carried the ball 11 times for 41 yards and a touchdown and caught four of five targets for 63 yards in Sunday's 28-24 win over Kansas City.

items.headline: Makes key grabs in Week 8 win
items.text: Waddle caught three of six targets for 39 yards and a touchdown and added a two-point conversion in Sunday's 28-24 win over Kansas City.

items.headline: Finds end zone against Detroit
items.text: Hockenson caught four of five targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-15 loss to the Lions.

items.headline: Added to Week 9 injury report
items.text: Fannin (groin) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice, Scott Petrak of the Elyria Chronicle-Telegram reports.

items.headline: Reaches paydirt in Week 8
items.text: Downs caught four of five targets for 23 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.

items.headline: Begins running, but lacks timetable
items.text: Pittman (foot) said Monday that he resumed running last week as part of a program to return, but the wideout acknowledged that he's without a clear timeline to be activated from injured reserve, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.

items.headline: Records two total TDs on Sunday
items.text: Prescott was 19-for-29 passing for 195 yards, one touchdown and no interceptions while rushing seven times for 20 yards and one more TD during Sunday's 33-30 overtime defeat to the Cardinals.

items.headline: Manages solid rushing total in shutout
items.text: Robinson rushed 19 times for 76 yards and failed to bring in his only target in the Falcons' 16-0 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday.

items.headline: Three-TD night in win
items.text: Swift rushed 27 times for 69 yards and three touchdowns and brought in two of three targets for 10 yards in the Bears' 34-17 win over the Seahawks on Monday night.

items.headline: Blanked with top two QBs injured
items.text: Flowers failed to bring in any of his five targets in the Ravens' 36-10 loss to the Bills on Sunday.

items.headline: Picturesque TD catch in loss
items.text: Jefferson brought in five of nine targets for 33 yards and a touchdown in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

items.headline: Good to go for TNF
items.text: Meyers (hamstring/ankle) does not carry an injury designation going into Thursday's game at the Ravens.

items.headline: Back in end zone during win
items.text: Kraft secured all six targets for 53 yards and a touchdown in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday.

items.headline: Leading rusher in Week 8 loss
items.text: Gordon carried the ball 19 times for 69 yards in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots. He failed to catch his only target.

items.headline: Clutch TD toss in win
items.text: Goff completed 18 of 25 passes for 176 yards with a touchdown and an interception and added three carries for no gain in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings on Sunday.

items.headline: No targets in Week 8
items.text: Cooper did not garner a target during Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders.

items.headline: Ties season high with 57 rec yards
items.text: Robinson caught six of seven targets for 57 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals. He also lost a fumble.

items.headline: Two TD passes in OT loss
items.text: Stroud completed 17 of 28 passes for 153 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants. He added two rushing attempts for four yards and threw a successful two-point conversion.

items.headline: Not expected to return Week 9
items.text: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Tuesday that Conner (foot) won't return from IR this week, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

items.headline: Still targeting December return
items.text: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

items.headline: Tosses three TDs in losing effort
items.text: Mahomes completed 30 of 41 passes for 321 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos. He added six rushing yards on two carries.

items.headline: Garners 119 scrimmage yards in loss
items.text: Hubbard rushed 22 times for 81 yards and a touchdown and brought in seven of eight targets for 38 yards in the Panthers' 27-19 loss to the Packers on Thursday.

items.headline: Solid all-around day in OT win
items.text: Brown rushed 12 times for 55 yards and brought in eight of nine targets for 46 yards in the Bengals' 43-36 overtime win over the Titans on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

items.headline: Seven more catches in Week 8
items.text: Lamb recorded seven catches (on 11 targets) for 58 yards during Sunday's 33-30 overtime loss to the Cardinals.

items.headline: DNP due to knee injury
items.text: Nabers didn't practice Thursday due to a knee injury, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

items.headline: Little with four catches Sunday
items.text: Warren secured four of 10 targets for 18 yards in the Colts' 42-7 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.

items.headline: Limited participant Thursday
items.text: Moore (knee) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.

items.headline: Leads ground attack in win
items.text: Corum rushed 11 times for 73 yards and a touchdown and failed to bring in his only target in the Rams' 24-9 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

items.headline: Playing through left knee issue
items.text: Young has been playing through a left knee issue since initially suffering the injury in Week 3 against the Browns, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

items.headline: Practices fully Thursday
items.text: Hall (quadriceps) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.

items.headline: Busy day in Week 8 win
items.text: Nacua secured 11 of 12 targets for 80 yards and a touchdown in the Rams' 24-9 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

items.headline: Thursday's DNP confirmed
items.text: Brown (ankle/knee) was a non-participant at Thursday's practice, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

items.headline: Likely out Monday, won't go on IR
items.text: Murray likely won't play Monday against the Bills due to a hamstring strain, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

items.headline: Workload to be decided on week-to-week basis
items.text: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak said Wednesday that the breakdown in carries between Jeanty and Mike Washington will be determined on a week-to-week basis, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

items.headline: Remains quiet in Week 8 win
items.text: Washington brought in one of two targets for 16 yards and rushed once for 10 yards in the Jaguars' 42-7 win over the Colts on Sunday.

items.headline: Game-winning TD in divisional clash
items.text: Williams brought in four of six targets for 70 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings on Sunday.

items.headline: Pair of catches in Week 8 loss
items.text: Barner brought in two of five targets for 23 yards in the Seahawks' 34-17 loss to the Bears on Monday night.

items.headline: Stretches TD streak to six games
items.text: Cook rushed 21 times for 80 yards and a touchdown while catching two of three targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens.

items.headline: Stays hot in Week 9 win
items.text: Love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and recovered a fumble in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday.

items.headline: Set to play Sunday amid trade rumors
items.text: Taylor was a full participant at Thursday's practice, and Stephen Holder of ESPN.com reports that both Taylor and head coach Shane Steichen have maintained that Taylor will play Sunday against the Cowboys despite ongoing trade rumors surrounding the star running back.

items.headline: Overshadowed by rookie backup in Week 8 loss
items.text: Walker carried the ball 21 times for 69 yards and caught four of five targets for 15 yards in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos.

items.headline: Quiet game in McCarthy's first start
items.text: Likely caught two of four targets for 12 yards in Sunday's 27-21 overtime win over the Texans.
